method: Read forward, backward, ownership and materialization control flow against exact source hashes; directly compile audited ops.cpp for existing CPU FD/parity controls. No CUDA execution or timing claim.

audited_subset.finding: New Variable from moved result; per-instance DevState is initially nullptr. Host-produced fresh Matrix retains host authority.

Materializes input before host forward; output is new host Matrix. Backward materializes upstream gradient. Saved immutable input/output remain host coherent because no supported operation mutates them.
Materializes both operands before host forward; new host output; backward materializes upstream gradient. Same immutable tape assumption.
Materializes condition and both operands; condition retained as parent with no gradient; selection backward materializes upstream gradient.
Input materialized before host read; new host outputs; backward materializes upstream gradient. rowmax captures argmax indices and uses first tie; no re-read of device input needed.

Materializes data before host mutation and gradient before derivative mutation. Under documented fresh matmul/add pattern, produced x has no cached input DevState slot or explicit resident table entry. Clearing stale flag makes host the authoritative source for later consumer upload. Existing CPU finite-difference and out-of-place loss/all-gradient parity controls pass.

authority_invariants.fact: vcache_hit only serves stale current-epoch entries. materialize downloads stale content then marks stale false. window_operand can separately serve a same-epoch Variable slot or explicit resident table.
Inplace contract requires no other consumer and excludes producers whose backward reads their own output. Fresh matmul/add result is the blessed pattern.
Explicit resident buffers require caller invalidate or refreshed make_resident after host mutation.

excluded_candidate.trigger: Use x in one matmul to cache its same-epoch slot, mutate x with inplace op, then use x in a second matmul; or mutate explicitly resident buffer without invalidation.
excluded_candidate.disposition: Not a supported correctness bug: first violates no-other-consumer inplace contract; second violates explicit resident mutation contract. No patch or paid gate is warranted from this trigger.
excluded_candidate.important_limit: This does not prove arbitrary host mutation is automatically invalidated or extend public inplace semantics.

controls.inplace: All three safe fresh-matmul ops, finite differences on both parents, out-of-place loss/all-gradient parity, tape-node count. NoGrad is exercised during finite difference evaluation.
controls.expression: Existing expression parser/value/shape/FD and Flex controls; CPU only.

remaining: Other ops.cpp wrappers/backward closures not listed here remain outside this bounded audit.
CUDA model families, custom expressions under unusual residency transitions, optimizers/export/other host consumers retain their separate evidence requirements.
No exhaustive audit closure, performance or residency improvement is claimed.
